about_the_game:
Doomclock is a fast-paced roguelite arena shooter with deckbuilding at its core. Dive into brutal, top-down action as you fend off relentless hordes, build a personalized deck, and wield an ever-growing arsenal to stop the Apocalypse in its tracks.

Build Your Deck

Choose from dozens of unique cards to craft your playstyle. Unlock powerful passives, new weapons, and active abilities through achievements and feats of strength. Discover hidden synergies and secret combos that can turn the tide of battle.

No Pauses!

Every moment counts—level-ups, upgrades, and shop interactions happen in real time. There are no pauses. Think fast, adapt on the fly, and survive the chaos. Each run lasts up to 20 intense minutes.

Slaughter Your Enemies

Slay enemies to earn experience and gold for mid-run upgrades and long-term progression. Face off against seven distinct enemy types and four unique bosses. Watch the blood fly—literally—and manage the gore or invest in handy helmet wipers to keep your vision clear.

Can you beat the clock, or will the Apocalypse win?

Features:

  • Auto-firing

  • Fast runs (up to 20 minutes, no pauses)

  • Multiple characters (each with their own skill tree)

  • Dozens of different cards (passives, weapons and active skills)

  • Multiple hidden synergies

  • Earn experience to level up during each run, and collect gold to spend at the shopkeeper or unlock meta progression

  • Screen gets soaked in gore—clean it or invest in helmet wipers

  • 7 different enemies and 4 unique bosses

content_descriptors.notes: Doomclock contains fantasy violence from a top-down perspective, including combat with demons, undead, and other dark creatures.
